title: A Cover Letter for an Internship

writingModel: Cover Letter: DataBridge Solutions Student Internship

I am writing to apply for the Student Software Internship position at DataBridge Solutions, which I found advertised on the WKU Careers Portal. I am currently a second-year Computer Science student at WKU in Uralsk, and I believe this internship would be an excellent opportunity to develop my professional skills in a real-world environment.

I have been studying computer science for two years, and I have been developing practical skills in parallel with my studies. I have been building a student timetable application for WKU in my spare time — a project that currently has over thirty active users. I have been studying machine learning independently for the past six weeks, working through online courses and applying what I have learned to real datasets. I am particularly interested in the work DataBridge Solutions is doing in data analysis for education, as this aligns closely with my own interests and career goals.

I would be a strong candidate for this internship for several reasons. First, I have experience working on real, user-facing software — not just academic projects. Second, I take responsibility seriously and have been told that I show initiative and follow through on commitments. Third, I have been improving my professional communication skills, and I am confident I can contribute to team meetings and client-facing interactions.
I am available to begin the internship on the first of June and can commit to the full eight-week programme. I have attached my CV and a link to my student timetable project for your review.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application further. I look forward to hearing from you.
